name: red python minor
source:
FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm AS packages
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: red distribution
source:
FROM --platform=linux/amd64 debian:bookworm
RUN echo https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/

name: red untagged
source:
FROM python
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean patch
source:
FROM mirror.gcr.io/library/python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean digest
source:
FROM python@sha256:2986c55feb36e6cae00fa1fefb454283e4b33f35e75ff8bdd123b134130be301
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean independent stages
source:
FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm AS build
RUN python --version
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: red earlier stage
source:
FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm AS build
RUN echo debian_snapshot
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm

name: red argument
clean argument
source:
ARG BASE="python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm"
FROM $BASE
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean pinned inheritance
source:
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm AS base
FROM base AS child
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: red floating inheritance
source:
FROM python:latest AS base
FROM base AS child
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean stage local argument
source:
ARG BASE=python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm AS first
ARG BASE=python:latest
FROM ${BASE}
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean replacement argument
source:
ARG BASE=python:latest
ARG BASE=python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: red replacement argument
source:
ARG BASE=python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
ARG BASE=python:latest
FROM ${BASE}
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: red unresolved argument
clean nested argument
source:
ARG VERSION=3.12.12
ARG BASE=python:${VERSION}-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean numeric inheritance
source:
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
FROM 0
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: red heredoc
source:
FROM python:latest
RUN <<'EOF'
echo https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/
EOF

name: clean comment
source:
FROM python:latest
# RUN echo debian_snapshot
RUN python --version

source:

RUN echo debian_snapshot

source:
FROM python:latest
RUN python <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
snapshot="https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/"
PY

name: clean Python heredoc
source:
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
RUN python <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
snapshot="https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/"

name: red embedded Dockerfile
source:
FROM python:latest
RUN cat <<EOF
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
RUN echo debian_snapshot
EOF

name: red quoted heredoc operator
source:
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm AS pinned
RUN echo "<<EOF"
FROM python:latest AS packages
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean quoted heredoc operator
source:
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm AS pinned
RUN echo "<<EOF"
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm AS packages

name: red escaped heredoc operator
source:

RUN echo \<\<EOF
FROM python:latest AS packages
RUN echo debian_snapshot

name: clean tabbed heredoc
source:
FROM python:3.12.12-slim-bookworm
RUN cat <<-'EOF'
	FROM python:latest
	echo debian_snapshot
	EOF
